title: Pipedrive vs Zoho CRM: Pipeline Setup and Migration Guide
description: Pipedrive and Zoho CRM can both support sales pipeline work, but teams should compare how much record structure, customization, automation, and cross-team process they need. Evaluate pipeline stages, lead and account records, permissions, reporting, integrations, migration effort, and total cost with the same sample workflow. Current plan limits and pricing are not independently verified; confirm official vendor terms.

verdict: Choose based on the sales process your team actually runs, not an unverified overall score. Use the same sample leads, stages, activities, permissions, and reports in both products. Record where configuration or administration becomes difficult, then verify current capabilities, plan limits, security terms, data export, and renewal conditions directly with each vendor. The available record does not establish a controlled benchmark or a universal winner.

faqs.question: What is the main difference between Pipedrive and Zoho CRM?
faqs.answer: Pipedrive and Zoho CRM can both support sales pipeline work, but teams should compare how much record structure, customization, automation, and cross-team process they need. Evaluate pipeline stages, lead and account records, permissions, reporting, integrations, migration effort, and total cost with the same sample workflow. Current plan limits and pricing are not independently verified; confirm official vendor terms.

faqs.question: Can Pipedrive replace Zoho CRM?
faqs.answer: Do not assume so. List the specific workflows, records, controls, reports, and integrations you depend on in Zoho CRM; test whether Pipedrive meets each requirement before changing systems.

faqs.question: Can a team use Pipedrive and Zoho CRM together?
faqs.answer: Potentially, if the team needs both workflows. Define which product owns each data field and process step, how records synchronize, how duplicates are handled, and who maintains the integration.

faqs.question: How should I compare their pricing?
faqs.answer: Use current vendor quotes for the same team size and workload. Include seats, usage limits, add-ons, implementation, integration work, training, administration, support, and renewal terms.

faqs.question: What should I test before choosing?
faqs.answer: Use realistic sample data and the same written acceptance criteria for both products. Record workflow completion, missing capabilities, reporting quality, migration effort, permissions, export options, and the total cost to operate.
